subject: General Updates
detail: We hereby informed the Exchange that the Allotment Committee meeting held on 20/11/2026 has approved the allotment of Equity shares for consideration other than cash on a preferential basis. Detailed letter is enclosed.

subject: Resignation
detail: SEPC Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Ms. Gayathri Sundaram as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 26, 2026. Detailed letter is enclosed.
